verdict.rationale: Adyen is a payments platform and API provider, not an AI agent or LLM host, so acting as an MCP client that plugs in external MCP servers to use their tools is outside its product role. The evidence shows only the opposite role: Adyen publishes its own MCP server for other LLM clients to connect to, which does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
